request.purpose: Policy-making: planning hospital capacity and care pathways for the coming years.
request.question: How many inpatient stays in 2025 had a hip fracture as main diagnosis, by age band?
definitions: Hip fracture stay = inpatient stay whose main diagnosis (primary_icd10) starts with S72.
Count stays (not patients) whose start_date is in 2025.
Report per age band: hip fracture stays.
